role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 昆卡总是对敌人的动向了如指掌。他可以操控一股涌流或一艘幽灵船对一个地点发动袭击，如果目标无误，他和他的盟友就能毫不费力地收拾残局。
hero_summary_en: Kunkka is always predicting where his enemies will go next. Able to attack a location with a geyser of water or a ghostly shipwreck, should his aim prove true, he and his allies will have no trouble cleaning up whatever is left.

abilities.name: kunkka_torrent
abilities.description_zh: 召唤喷涌的洪流，短暂延迟后，将敌人冲上天，造成伤害、眩晕和减速。
abilities.description_en: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
notes_zh: 初始泡泡效果仅对队友可见，并且提供战争迷雾中的视野。
飞到半空的单位将会被眩晕并且可以被攻击。
notes_en: The initial bubble effect is only visible to allies and provides vision in fog of war.
Units tossed in the air will be stunned and still able to be attacked.

abilities.name: kunkka_tidebringer
abilities.description_zh: 昆卡的传奇之剑使他的下一次攻击附加额外的攻击力并在前方造成大范围的分裂攻击伤害。
abilities.description_en: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.
facet_text_en: Tidebringer cooldown is reduced per enemy hero it hits.
facet_text_zh: 潮汐使者每击中一名英雄，冷却时间都会减少。

abilities.name: kunkka_x_marks_the_spot
abilities.description_zh: 对友方或敌方英雄使用，用 X 标记他们当前位置，数秒后将他们送回 X 标记处。在技能持续时间内，昆卡可以手动触发送回。对友方英雄使用后持续时间加倍。
abilities.description_en: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds.  Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.
facet_text_en: When X Marks the Spot returns its target, Kunkka and allies near the return spot gain Ghostship's Admiral's Rum buff.
facet_text_zh: X标记送回目标后，昆卡和回归点附近友军都会获得幽灵船的统帅朗姆酒效果。

abilities.name: kunkka_admirals_rum
abilities.description_zh: 如果昆卡受到来自敌方英雄、建筑或肉山的伤害会使他的生命低于%damage_threshold%%%临界值，那么他会浸在统帅朗姆酒中，获得移动速度加成，并且延后承受即将受到的%ghostship_absorb%%%伤害，持续%buff_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Damage from enemy heroes, buildings, or Roshan that would reduce Kunkka below %damage_threshold%%% threshold causes him to douse himself with The Admiral's Rum, receiving bonus movement speed and a delayed reaction to %ghostship_absorb%%% of incoming damage for %buff_duration%s.
notes_zh: 在朗姆酒效果消失后造成的伤害不能致死，而且不能杀死英雄。
notes_en: Damage dealt after Rum wears off is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.

abilities.name: kunkka_tidal_wave
abilities.description_zh: 释放一道在昆卡身后出现的潮汐波。造成点伤害，并将敌人沿着波浪拖拽距离。敌人被拖拽时无法攻击。
abilities.description_en: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.

abilities.name: kunkka_ghostship
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一艘幽灵船驶过战场，直到撞成粉碎，残骸周围的敌人将会因撞击受到伤害并眩晕。被幽灵船碰到的友军会获得2倍效果的统帅朗姆酒。
abilities.description_en: Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a %rum_factor%x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
notes_zh: 幽灵船实际的碰撞范围比船本身大。
notes_en: Actual area of effect of ship's collision is larger than the boat itself.
The boat has a movement speed of %ghostship_speed%.

scepter_loc.en: Ghostship creates a fleet of %fleet_count% ships at the target point on a %fleet_interval% second interval. Each ship now also fires %num_cannon_volleys% waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal %cannon_ball_damage_pct%%% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.
scepter_loc.zh: 幽灵船在目标地点以%fleet_interval%秒的间隔产生%fleet_count%艘船组成的舰队。每艘船现在还会从左舷和右舷发射%num_cannon_volleys%波炮弹，穿过敌人时造成%cannon_ball_damage_pct%%%幽灵船伤害。
